display_name: 独立滤波与 DURA 的源域方向互补性
description: 对固定自适应滤波和时变滤波模型，测量其输出减 DURA 输出方向上的源 IQ 理想步长，仅作不可部署诊断。

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source per-record clean-IQ oracle line, not deployable or identity accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed original DURA and independently trained adaptive/time-varying source checkpoints
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Each fixed source-only checkpoint verified by its loader; no selection or target training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prespecified candidate final epoch5; no target score selection

expected_artifacts: result.json source line oracle results for fixed and time-varying directions

metric_names: positive improvement and negative optimum count

rows.method: Use direct output minus DURA as RMS-normalized direction, bounded positive [0,0.5] and signed [-0.5,0.5] per-record source clean oracle steps
rows.purpose: Assess source-only complementarity of independently trained filter models with DURA
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: Per-record ideal steps require same-record source clean IQ; never used in target inference.
Source pilot previously explored, DURA may have seen same source domain; no F/TX/V/target or model updates.
mean_optimal_alpha is before truncation, oracle NMSE uses bounded steps; not an identity result or general performance bound.
